report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified. Current traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200/ok. Deployment record shows only order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so no deployment change is established. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders with 0 502s and p95 230ms; v2.0.0 shows zero traffic. No current evidence establishes a bounded root cause; hand off for more telemetry.
